Why Choose TSRS

Built Different.
Positioned Better.

While competitors cluster in the Midwest, TSRS operates from the Gulf Coast — putting us closer to Southern Corridor railroads, ports, and manufacturing partners. That means faster turnarounds and a leaner supply chain for you.

Reliable

Consistent quality backed by AAR M-1003 certification and rigorous QA processes on every component we touch.

Responsive

Quick communication and adaptive scheduling. We move at the pace your operations demand, not ours.

Capable

Global Reach

What We Do

Core Capabilities &
Services

TSRS delivers end-to-end rail component solutions — from sourcing and fabrication to certified reconditioning — all under one roof in Dayton, Texas.

01

Bolster & Side Frame Reconditioning

AAR M-1003 certified process covering full inspection, wear surface replacement, welding, and finishing. We bring worn components back to spec — extending asset life and reducing capital spend.

02

Truck Mounted Air Brake Rebuilding

Complete disassembly, inspection, and rebuild of truck-mounted brake assemblies. All work meets AAR and FRA standards with full documentation and traceability.

03

Rail Subassembly Sourcing

Major and minor rail subassemblies sourced through our vetted supplier network. We identify the right components at the right price — domestically and internationally.

04

Fabrication & Custom Welding

Custom fabrication and precision welding to customer specifications. Whether it's structural repairs or one-off components, our shop delivers certified-quality work.

05

International Foundry Access

Direct relationships with international foundries give our customers access to competitively priced castings and components — with TSRS managing quality and logistics.

06

OEM Component Supply

Supplying OEM-grade rail components to manufacturers and repair facilities across the Gulf Coast corridor. Consistent availability, reliable lead times, documented compliance.

Compliance & Quality

Certified to the
Highest Standard

AAR M-1003 Certified

Our primary facility certification — the gold standard for quality management in the rail industry. Every reconditioned component meets M-1003 requirements.

AAR M-214 Compliance

All applicable work complies with AAR M-214 specifications for reconditioned components used in interchange service.

ISO 9001:2015 Partner Network

Select manufacturing and foundry partners carry ISO 9001:2015 certification — ensuring quality management standards extend across our full supply chain.

"AAR M-1003 isn't a checkbox — it's the foundation of every component we return to service."

TSRS built its operations around certification compliance from day one. When you source from us or send components for reconditioning, you're working with a facility that's been vetted, audited, and approved to meet the rail industry's most demanding standards.


All suppliers meet AAR M-1003 Quality Standards
